category_title: Underprepared writers who procrastinate on topic selection and narrowing
scenario_title: Procrastination on Topic Selection for a 15-Page Paper
minimal_context: The student is attempting to select and narrow down a topic for a 15-page research paper on a social problem during a summer bridge program.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to select a topic for your 15-page research paper on a social problem. What are you thinking of writing about?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have anything yet. I thought it was boring to choose a specific topic beforehand.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to pick something so you can begin working on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I guess I didn't really believe that it matters if you narrow down your topic before you start writing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think will happen if you keep waiting?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just wasting all my time trying to find what I want to write about. It's like the less I work on my paper, the more years I take off my life, but I just can't quit procrastinating.
